excluded_and_must_measure: sparse indices, flags and dense-sparse selection
conclusions: The fixed Gaussian phi/psi construction can share one Omega; two maps must not be charged unless actually present.
Rank3 dense PSAC fits the proposed additional-state cap; rank4 and8 dense do not. Sparse storage can change feasibility and must be checked before rejecting a rank.
A common base Hadamard can be counted outside the incremental cap only when it is identical and resident for all methods.
No speed, effect, total-memory equality, or implementation-completeness claim follows from this arithmetic.
